candidates.statement: Payment service /v1/authorizations calls time out (~2s ReadTimeout), causing order to fail and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side latency metrics/logs not available; timeout cause (slow payment vs network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show consistent ~2s ReadTimeout on payment authorizations propagating to order and gateway 502s; inventory/redis succeed. Payment-side telemetry needed to confirm root cause.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics and logs for /v1/authorizations
Order service internal timing to confirm payment is the blocking dependency
